args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production, across all production regions. After the rollback, error rate dropped to 0.2% and the service is now healthy. Root cause in v2.3.1 still needs investigation.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent version that was healthy in production — across all production regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The incident summary documents the failure, the rollback, and that root cause in v2.3.1 still needs investigation.
